verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־ הוֹשֵׁ֙עַ֙ בֶּן־ בְּאֵרִ֔י בִּימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֥ה יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֛י יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- hō·wō·šê·a‘ ben- bə·’ê·rî bî·mê ‘uz·zî·yāh yō·w·ṯām ’ā·ḥāz yə·ḥiz·qî·yāh mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇî·mê yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- yō·w·’āš me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah Jotham Ahaz and Hezekiah kings of Judah and of Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel
verses.literalPt: PALAVRA do SENHOR, que foi dirigida a Oséias, filho de Beeri, nos dias de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz, Ezequias, reis de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, filho de Joás, rei de Israel.

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבֶּר־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּהוֹשֵׁ֑עַ פ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ הוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לֵ֣ךְ קַח־ לְךָ֞ אֵ֤שֶׁת זְנוּנִים֙ וְיַלְדֵ֣י זְנוּנִ֔ים כִּֽי־ זָנֹ֤ה תִזְנֶה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵֽאַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḥil·laṯ dib·ber- Yah·weh bə·hō·šē·aʿ p̄ way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- hō·wō·šê·a‘ lêḵ qaḥ- lə·ḵā ’ê·šeṯ zə·nū·nîm wə·yal·ḏê zə·nū·nîm kî- zā·nōh ṯiz·neh hā·’ā·reṣ mê·’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea He told . . . him Go take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself . . . by departing from the LORD
verses.literalPt: O princípio da palavra do SENHOR por meio de Oséias. Disse, pois, o SENHOR a Oséias: Vai, toma uma mulher de prostituições, e filhos de prostituição; porque a terra certamente se prostitui, desviando-se do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיִּקַּ֔ח אֶת־ גֹּ֖מֶר בַּת־ דִּבְלָ֑יִם וַתַּ֥הַר וַתֵּֽלֶד־ ל֖וֹ בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- gō·mer baṯ- diḇ·lā·yim wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ- lōw bên
verses.literal: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim and she conceived and bore him a son
verses.literalPt: Foi, pois, e tomou a Gômer, filha de Diblaim, e ela concebeu, e lhe deu um filho.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יִזְרְעֶ֑אל כִּי־ ע֣וֹד מְעַ֗ט וּפָ֨קַדְתִּ֜י אֶת־ דְּמֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יֵה֔וּא וְהִ֨שְׁבַּתִּ֔י מַמְלְכ֖וּת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāw qə·rā šə·mōw yiz·rə·‘el kî- ‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ’eṯ- də·mê yiz·rə·‘el ‘al- bêṯ yê·hū wə·hiš·bat·tî mam·lə·ḵūṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Hosea Name him . . . Jezreel for soon . . . I will bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe o SENHOR: Põe-lhe o nome de Jizreel; porque daqui a pouco visitarei o sangue de Jizreel sobre a casa de Jeú, e farei cessar o reino da casa de Israel.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ קֶ֣שֶׁת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·šā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- qe·šeṯ yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ê·meq yiz·rə·‘el
verses.literal: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel
verses.literalPt: E naquele dia quebrarei o arco de Israel no vale de Jizreel.

verses.original: וַתַּ֤הַר עוֹד֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בַּ֔ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ קְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖הּ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אוֹסִ֜יף ע֗וֹד אֲרַחֵם֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ נָשֹׂ֥א אֶשָּׂ֖א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har ‘ō·wḏ wat·tê·leḏ baṯ way·yō·mer lōw qə·rā šə·māh lō ru·ḥā·māh kî lō ’ō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ ’ă·ra·ḥêm ’eṯ- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî- nā·śō ’eś·śā lā·hem
verses.literal: Gomer again conceived and gave birth to a daughter and the LORD said to Hosea Name her Lo-ruhamah for I will no longer . . . have compassion on the house of Israel that I should ever forgive . . . them
verses.literalPt: E tornou ela a conceber, e deu à luz uma filha. E Deus disse: Põe-lhe o nome de Lo-Ruama; porque eu não tornarei mais a compadecer-me da casa de Israel, mas tudo lhe tirarei.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֲרַחֵ֔ם וְהֽוֹשַׁעְתִּ֖ים בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א אֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֗ם בְּקֶ֤שֶׁת וּבְחֶ֙רֶב֙ וּבְמִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּסוּסִ֖ים וּבְפָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·ra·ḥêm wə·hō·wō·ša‘·tîm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·lō ’ō·wō·šî·‘êm bə·qe·šeṯ ū·ḇə·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇə·mil·ḥā·māh bə·sū·sîm ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šîm
verses.literal: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah and I will save them not by bow or sword or war not by horses and cavalry but by the LORD their God
verses.literalPt: Mas da casa de Judá me compadecerei, e os salvarei pelo SENHOR seu Deus, pois não os salvarei pelo arco, nem pela espada, nem pela guerra, nem pelos cavalos, nem pelos cavaleiros.

verses.original: וַתִּגְמֹ֖ל אֶת־ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḡ·mōl ’eṯ- lō ru·ḥā·māh wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ bên
verses.literal: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah Gomer conceived and gave birth to a son
verses.literalPt: E, depois de haver desmamado a Lo-Ruama, concebeu e deu à luz um filho.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֑י כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹֽא־ אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qə·rā šə·mōw lō ‘am·mî kî ’at·tem lō ‘am·mî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō- ’eh·yeh lå̄·ḵɛm
verses.literal: And the LORD said Name him Lo-ammi for you are not My people and I am not your God . . .
verses.literalPt: E Deus disse: Põe-lhe o nome de Lo-Ami; porque vós não sois meu povo, nem eu serei vosso Deus.

verses.original: וְֽ֠הָיָה מִסְפַּ֤ר בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יִמַּ֖ד וְלֹ֣א יִסָּפֵ֑ר וְֽ֠הָיָה בִּמְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לֹֽא־ עַמִּ֣י אַתֶּ֔ם יֵאָמֵ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אֵֽל־ חָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh mis·par bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḥō·wl hay·yām ’ă·šer lō- yim·maḏ wə·lō yis·sā·p̄êr wə·hā·yāh bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yê·’ā·mêr lā·hem lō- ‘am·mî ’at·tem yê·’ā·mêr lā·hem bə·nê ’êl- ḥāy
verses.literal: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea which cannot be measured or counted And it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them You are not My people they will be called . . . sons of the living God
verses.literalPt: Todavia o número dos filhos de Israel será como a areia do mar, que não pode medir-se nem contar-se; e acontecerá que no lugar onde se lhes dizia: Vós não sois meu povo, se lhes dirá: Vós sois filhos do Deus vivo.

verses.original: וְ֠נִקְבְּצוּ בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֤ה וּבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְשָׂמ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם רֹ֥אשׁ אֶחָ֖ד וְעָל֣וּ מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י גָד֖וֹל י֥וֹם יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niq·bə·ṣū bə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl yaḥ·dāw wə·śā·mū lā·hem rōš ’e·ḥāḏ wə·‘ā·lū min- hā·’ā·reṣ kî ḡā·ḏō·wl yō·wm yiz·rə·‘el
verses.literal: Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together and they will appoint for themselves one leader and will go up out of the land For great will be the day of Jezreel
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Judá e os filhos de Israel juntos se congregarão, e constituirão sobre si uma só cabeça, e subirão da terra; porque grande será o dia de Jizreel.
